title: Zilar fix plan
intro: Ten code audits (eight by Claude Fable 5.1, two by Claude Opus 5.5) read the whole app on 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-12. This page tracks the fixes. Status comes from the task files in work/.

audits.title: Message pipeline
highlights: Phone stayed online in the background, so pushes came late
Group messages never pushed to a closed app
A lost message could show as sent
Nothing caught up after a reconnect

audits.title: Contacts, groups and permissions
highlights: Blocking did not really block
Group owner cannot leave, hand over or delete
Removals reach other devices late

audits.title: Security and privacy
highlights: Admin API exposure (fixed)
Unsafe inline file types (fixed)
Database role scope (fixed)

audits.title: Message features and UI state
highlights: Reply quotes empty on the other device
False seen from a late history page
Last seen lies and flickers
Group typing shows one person

audits.title: Performance and battery
highlights: One history query per chat at every reconnect
About ten queries per group in the chat list, every 60 s
Mobile renders every message at once

audits.title: Mobile UX and gestures
highlights: List jumps to the bottom while reading older messages
No Sign out in the app
Back broken after opening from a notification
Keyboard hides the latest messages

audits.title: Web UX and flows
highlights: New message cannot start a DM
Group panel has no Leave or Add members
Drafts lost when switching chats
Composer not focused when opening a chat

audits.title: Telegram parity
highlights: Unread and read state only in client memory
No link previews
No delete for me, clear history or leave group
No sessions list or delete account

audits.title: AI chats and agents
highlights: Deploys drop AI replies being written
Web writing stream stops for good after an error
Rate limits shown as spending limit
Deleted messages stay in the AI context

audits.title: Operations and reliability
highlights: Backups were missing after the move (recreated 2026-10-12)
No alerting anywhere
Every deploy gives 30-60 s of errors

waves.title: Wave 1: the message pipeline
waves.goal: Messages and pushes arrive, on time and in order.

items.title: Push registration keeps its node; the app registers once
Mobile suspends its socket in the background and wakes on open
Push enable on every session, mobile and web
Honest sent tick and an outbox for offline texts
Offline texts go out when the network comes back (found on the emulator)
Server-side push for group messages
Pushes only for messages, oldest first

waves.title: Wave 2: security and blocking
waves.goal: Close the exposures the audits found.

items.title: Deploy hardening: proxy, headers, database role, proxy hops
Only safe file types render inline
Blocking really blocks
A web push endpoint has one owner
Only contacts can send direct messages
Mobile reads chat files through the checked proxy
Private uploads: the edge stops serving raw upload links
Failed topic-room syncs are retried until they succeed
A group owner can hand the group over (then leave)
Every secret redacted in logs; graceful stop time
Migration safety: numbering check, lock timeout, startup warning
Release signing and versioning for the Android app

waves.title: Wave 3: what you notice every day
waves.goal: Unread, seen, typing and replies tell the truth.

items.title: Seen only when the chat is really open and focused
Other-device replies clear unread; stable last seen; group typing per person
Unread counts and previews kept on the server
Catch-up after reconnect; the apps use the server's unread
Retry the token on reconnect instead of going offline
A revoked session goes to sign-in instead of retrying for ever
Delivered tick: the new state and its icons (delivered grey, seen green)
Delivered tick: the server stores delivery (DMs, and any member in groups)
Delivered tick: the apps report delivery and show it
Delivered tick: the sender sees it live, without a refresh
Delivered tick: a phone woken by a push reports delivery too
Reply quotes show on every device
Health reports ejabberd and push; an uptime check emails when something is down
Backups re-created: nightly dumps and volume backups to B2

waves.title: Wave 4: feel and parity
waves.goal: Close the gap with Telegram on web and Android.

Mobile: per-chat drafts
Mobile list keeps its place: older pages, new messages, keyboard
Mobile Sign out; Back after opening from a notification

Mobile: jump-to-bottom with a count; dragging closes the keyboard
Mobile: profile photos, DM header opens the profile, connection state in the chat
Mobile: swipe a chat for Pin, Mute, Archive
Mobile: a smoother full-screen image viewer
Mobile: a short mic press explains how to record
Mobile: open chats at the bottom instantly
Mobile: lock a voice recording
Web: one right edge for time, badge and ticks; clean hover
Web: confirm Sign out and archive; reply quotes jump; sign-in focus
Web: older messages load without a jump; arrow keys on every row; N for New chat
Web: Make owner in the group panel
Mobile: a typing or AI tick no longer re-renders every message row
Web: one ball colour per person, AI or group
Mobile: one ball colour per person, AI or group
Web New message lists contacts and opens the DM
Web search: people open the chat, honest empty states, Esc
Web Notifications page: one clear message, no dead Enable
Group panel: Leave group, Add members, Remove
Fewer queries per push notification
Chat list loads all group topics in one batched pass
Fewer archive queries per reconnect
Web: windowed message list; background chats pruned
Budgets on invites, profile edits, group create; group pictures for members only
AI in groups: says when rate-limited; a reply to it wakes it
AI replies survive deploys
Web AI writing stream reconnects; tool progress keeps it
Honest AI error messages; one retry; cut-short replies say so
Edited and deleted messages leave the AI's context
Near-zero-downtime deploys and safe migrations

waves.goal: The 12-step fix plan of the Telegram parity audit (docs/audit/telegram-parity-audit.md §4): what a Telegram user misses first.

waves.title: Wave 6: found by testing on the emulator
waves.goal: Bugs the lead found on 2026-10-12 by running release builds against production.

items.title: A text sent offline goes out when the network is back
A text whose confirmation was lost is resent once, not stuck
Back online within 20 s after a long gap; a resent text gets its tick
The server counts a resent message once
History shows a resent message once
A resent message arriving live shows once
Mobile requests give up after 20 s instead of hanging
The voice hint is readable; the test notification shows with the app open
A failed swipe action says so
Main typechecks again after two tasks met
